document: G3-C.1 determinism: the pre-registered selection and the oracle/condition gold regenerate byte-identically from frozen inputs when re-executed.
method: snapshot sha256 -> in-process re-execution of evidence.g3c1_select.main() then evidence.g3c1_gold.main() -> re-snapshot sha256; no git write-tree, pytest, server or network call was invoked (g3c1_gold reads the existing audit/g3c1_freshness_recompute.json cache).
note: No build timestamp enters the selection or either gold file: selection is canonical (sorted keys); gold rows derive only from pre/post executed facts, totals and the frozen gold rule (truth's built_at label-provenance is not copied into gold).
